newsitem.title: JAPAN: PRESS DIGEST - TOP JAPAN BUSINESS NEWS - AUG 14.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - TOP JAPAN BUSINESS NEWS - AUG 14.

text.p: Following are some of the leading stories in the Japanese press on Thursday, as reported by Kyodo news agency.
-- International Monetary Fund (IMF) calls on Japan to step up supervision of financial system.
-- Financial holding companies will be allowed to hold up to 10 to 20 percent of shares of non-financial firms.
-- Hokkaido Bank Ltd and Hokkaido Takushoku Bank Ltd mulling to postpone their merger plan, which is scheduled for April 1, 1998.
-- Personnel exchanged between government and private sector to be treated as regular staff members.
-- IMF urges Japan to raise official discount rate by year- end.
-- Osaka named Japan's candidate for 2008 Olympics.
-- Annual defence programme to include steps for emergencies near Japan.
-- Government plans to use profits from postal savings to pay interest on defunct Japanese National Railways' debts.
